title: Cohomology of ring derived Hom computes Ext
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $M,N$ be $R$-modules, and let $n\geq0$ be an integer. Let $R\operatorname{Hom}_R(M[0],N[0])$ be the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-point ringed site with structure ring $R$, and let $H^n$ be cohomology in its derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then $H^n(R\operatorname{Hom}_R(M[0],N[0]))$ is canonically isomorphic to $\operatorname{Ext}^n_R(M,N)$ [def-pc-ext], the group $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(R)}(M[0],N[0][n])$.
